CustomField.description: Visible label next to the Yes radio; when the quote already holds a PO it prints the implicit answer; when the Account is flagged PO Required it prints the credit-control-driven answer (no radios).
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(PO_Number__c)), "Yes (PO number below)", IF(TEXT(SBQQ__Account__r.PO_Required__c) = "Yes", "Yes - your organisation requires a PO on invoices", "Yes"))
CustomField.label: Order Form PO Required Yes Label
